findings.text: WALL_STROKE_DASH covers only the four named line styles (solid/dashed/dotted/dashdot) and .get(..., solid) falls back silently, but matplotlib also accepts the shorthand forms InkStyle.wall_linestyle would equally take ('--', ':', '-.'), so a caller passing one of those draws dashed/dotted in the socres matplotlib renderer and a solid line in the altair one; the two renderers diverge for any name outside the map.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified 2 production call site(s): imas_ink/server/mcp.py:231 and imas_ink/figures.py:395 (equilibrium_figure_mpl); both call without ax, so both keep creating their own figure and no caller changes behaviour.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit 3dc98af against base 5fad354, 6 files, all inside scope; geometry_figure_mpl gains an optional ax (creates plt.subplots only when ax is None, else fig = ax.get_figure()), InkStyle gains wall_linestyle default 'solid', _render_wall_mpl applies it to both limiter branches and the vessel shells, _render_wall_alt maps it through a new WALL_STROKE_DASH to altair strokeDash, and 4 tests are added.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when nominates `uv run --no-sync pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/unit` adding no failure against base and `uv run --no-sync ruff check imas_ink tests` adding no finding against base's 55, plus a two-axes composition test and a dashed-wall/vessel test in tests/unit/test_vessel_units.py; both nominated commands ran as written and the two tests exist and pass.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is an optional ax argument on geometry_figure_mpl that draws into the given axes and returns its figure instead of creating one, plus an InkStyle.wall_linestyle (default solid) applied by _render_wall_mpl and _render_wall_alt to the limiter outlines and the vessel shells so a reference state can be drawn dashed via the existing reference vocabulary; imas_ink/figures.py:183 honours ax, imas_ink/style.py:52 adds the field, and both wall renderers apply it.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records head 397 passed / 1 failed / 4 errors against base 393 / 1 / 4 with identical three_d ids, ruff 55 = base 55, a focused 10 passed, and a negative control that reddens the dashed test.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's 7 declared paths; every path in the diff is one of them (imas_ink/figures.py, style.py, mpl.py, alt.py, tests/unit/test_vessel_units.py, the evidence fragment) and no file outside them changed.

justifications.durability: the composition test (test_two_geometries_share_one_figure_via_ax) asserts both returned figures are the caller's and the figure count is unchanged, the dashed test asserts all three wall/vessel lines are dashed, and the sibling solid control test guards that the default stays solid; the manifest's negative control (making _render_wall_mpl always solid) reddens test_dashed_wall_and_vessel_lines while it passes at head, so the style path is genuinely exercised — though the altair dash test is importorskip and skips silently if altair is absent.
justifications.evidence: the base and head gate logs are the reviewed run's own baseline_suite and after_suite logs; base-suite.log ends '1 failed, 393 passed, 6 skipped, 34 deselected, 14 warnings, 4 errors' and head-suite.log '1 failed, 397 passed, ... 4 errors' with the identical five three_d/test_scene_cutaway.py ids, so added_failure_count is 0; base-ruff.log and head-ruff.log both end 'Found 55 errors.'; the two nominated commands ran as written and the focused file re-runs green here (10 passed), so the done-when is met rather than substituted.
justifications.fit: the ax branch keeps the existing subplots path verbatim so nothing changes without ax; wall_linestyle sits in InkStyle beside wall_color/wall_linewidth with a comment naming the reference-vocabulary use, and WALL_STROKE_DASH sits in alt.py beside the other render helpers; no forbidden name or plan label is introduced, and the only noted side effect is that the supplied-ax path still calls fig.tight_layout() on the caller's figure.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imes_ink/figures.py:183-186 draws into the caller's axes and returns ax.get_figure() (returning the caller's own Figure and Axes, creating none), imas_ink/style.py:52 adds wall_linestyle default 'solid', imas_ink/mpl.py:377/386/395 apply it to both limiter branches and every vessel shell, and imas_ink/alt.py:241 applies it to the altair wall mark — exactly the section's specified change, with the no-ax path unchanged.
justifications.reuse: the caller reuses the existing reference vocabulary as the plan intends — DEFAULT_STYLE.ref_lcfs_linestyle is 'dashed' and is a key in WALL_STROKE_DASH, so replace(DEFAULT_STYLE, wall_linestyle=DEFAULT_STYLE.ref_lcfs_linestyle) draws dashed in both renderers; no new owner or forked helper is introduced, the style field and the altair dash map extend their existing owners.
justifications.scope_discipline: all 6 changed files are inside the manifest's declared write paths (imas_ink/figures.py, imas_ink/style.py, imas_ink/mpl.py, imas_ink/alt.py, tests/unit/test_vessel_units.py, docs/evidence/fragments/geometry-figure-vessel-units/ink-compose-phases.html); no declared-but-unwritten figure path was committed and no file outside the declaration changed.
